subject.title: fix(reef): restore inbox recovery after gateway restart

question: Should this protected Reef recovery change require public redacted exact-head restart evidence and an explicit callback-compatibility confirmation before merge?
rationale: The functional tests and private pre-fix diagnosis are useful, but only the Reef owner can decide whether private operational diagnostics are sufficient for a delivery-critical recovery change and whether any public API transition is intentional.

options.title: Require public redacted proof
options.body: Require an exact-head restart transcript or terminal/log capture that shows cursor resume, connected status, and the failure diagnostic path, plus confirmation or coverage for the legacy callback constructor form.

options.title: Accept private owner verification
options.body: An owner may accept the withheld live diagnostics if they independently verify the exact head and explicitly accept the remaining public-proof and API-compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Require public redacted proof
recommendation.body: Require an exact-head restart transcript or terminal/log capture that shows cursor resume, connected status, and the failure diagnostic path, plus confirmation or coverage for the legacy callback constructor form.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the production diagnosis and authored the candidate recovery implementation, making them the most directly connected available reviewer for the proof boundary.
